resolution: The prima via itself defines moving as educing from potency to act (claim AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-REDUCED-BY-A-MOVER-A), and the case reads motus in that broad sense. Aristotle's physical change is one kind of such reduction, so the observation premise STMT-SOMETHING-IS-MOVED-IN-THIS-WORLD holds on either reading. All premises share `MovedIn`/`MovesIn` over an abstract `Respect`, so the formal results hold for any one reading applied throughout; an objection that the regress premises hold only for local motion is an objection to a premise, not an equivocation. BRIDGE-ARIST-MOTION-ANALYSIS-MOVED-AS-IN-POTENCY reads Physics III.1's definition (STMT-BEING-MOVED-IS-ACTUALIZATION-OF-POTENCY) with the same `MovedIn` as STMT-NOTHING-MOVED-EXCEPT-AS-IN-POTENCY. Aristotle states the definition for physical change; applied to the broad reading it is the definition extended to every reduction from potency to act, and the bridge carries his support to the premise only as far as that extension holds.
